# rauthy_user (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Rauthy user by `id` or by `email`, for referring to accounts this configuration does not manage. Exactly one of the two must be set.

The profile values a user maintains themselves are not exposed here; only the fields an administrator manages are.

Requires the `Users:read` API key right.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a user this configuration does not manage, by email or by id.
data "rauthy_user" "ada" {
  email = "ada@example.com"
}

data "rauthy_user" "by_id" {
  id = "9f9a1a1e-0d3f-4f1e-9a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Email address of the user. Set this or `id`.
- `id` (String) Rauthy-assigned identifier of the user. Set this or `email`.

### Read-Only

- `account_type` (String) How the account authenticates, as Rauthy reports it.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp in seconds at which the account was created.
- `email_verified` (Boolean) Whether the email address counts as verified.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the account may log in.
- `family_name` (String) Family name.
- `given_name` (String) Given name.
- `groups` (Set of String) Groups the user belongs to.
- `language` (String) Language used for the account's emails and the login UI.
- `preferred_username` (String) The username the user chose for themselves, if any.
- `roles` (Set of String) Roles granted to the user.
- `user_expires` (Number) Unix timestamp in seconds at which the account expires, if it does.
